identitySignals: OUSD agenda item 23-0900 names R3 Collaboratives, Inc. of San Francisco, CA as providing its Edthena online platform for teacher professional development to Allendale Elementary School, matching the agenda text and the 'Technology' category
Edthena's own website says it is operated by R3 Collaboratives (footer) and lists a San Francisco, CA address
California corporation record for R3 Collaboratives, Inc. shows a San Francisco principal address (95 3rd St), matching the agenda location and the Edthena contact page address
research.notes: Entity number comes from a third-party aggregator of California Secretary of State filings (bizprofile.net), not the Secretary of State site itself. Edthena is the product brand of R3 Collaboratives.

profile.summary: R3 Collaboratives is a San Francisco company that makes Edthena, an online platform for teachers and schools. Educators use it to record classroom video, get feedback and coaching from colleagues, and build their teaching skills.
